e.title: Insurers 101：把美国健康险经济学做成策略模拟，并用 17 次自动完整通关与 64 个受驱状态的截图来验证它
e.title_en: Insurers 101: turning U.S. health-insurance economics into a strategy simulation, verified by 17 automated full playthroughs and screenshots of 64 driven states
e.title_hk: Insurers 101：把美國健康險經濟學做成策略模擬，並用 17 次自動完整通關與 64 個受驅狀態的截圖來驗證它
e.summary: 一个美国健康险经济学的教育性策略模拟：你经营四家真实保险公司之一（信诺、联合健康、Elevance Health、Humana）十个财政年度，逐季经历「核保与定价 → 网络与供应商协议 → 理赔运营 → 董事会与监管」四步，途中被真实世界边缘案例打断，并可选股东价值、人群健康或自定权重组合作为目标；它用 17 次自动完整通关、逐家校准脚本与 64 个受驱状态的截图巡检来自证可运行
e.summary_hk: 一個美國健康險經濟學的教育性策略模擬：你經營四家真實保險公司之一（信諾、聯合健康、Elevance Health、Humana）十個財政年度，逐季經歷「核保與定價 → 網絡與供應商協議 → 理賠運營 → 董事會與監管」四步，途中被真實世界邊緣案例打斷，並可選股東價值、人群健康或自定權重組合作為目標；它用 17 次自動完整通關、逐家校準腳本與 64 個受驅狀態的截圖巡檢來自證可運行
e.summary_en: An educational strategy simulation of U.S. health-insurance economics: you run one of four real insurers (Cigna, UnitedHealth Group, Elevance Health, Humana) for ten fiscal years, quarter by quarter through underwriting and pricing, network and vendor deals, claims operations, and board review and regulation, interrupted by real-world edge cases, toward a chosen North Star of shareholder value, population health or a blend you weight yourself; it substantiates that it runs with 17 automated full playthroughs, a per-insurer calibration script and a screenshot sweep of 64 driven states
e.body:
**Insurers 101** 是一个**美国健康险经济学的教育性策略模拟**（仓库 `mttgbsn/Insurers101`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 636 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-06**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**⚠️ 该仓库根目录**没有许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404），**而其 README 末尾却逐字写着「License: MIT for code」**（**详见下方标注 ①**）；**无 topics**；**README 实测 4,238 字节**，**另有实测 `ARCHITECTURE.md`（29,534 字节）与 `CLAUDE.md`（2,564 字节）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「说清楚什么算它是对的」**中的**第四种，也是把「我怎么知道它能跑」写成可执行命令最彻底的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 与仓库根目录实测**）：**README 标题逐字为「Insurers: 101」**，**署名逐字为「by Matt Gibson」**，**并给出在线地址 `https://mttgbsn.github.io/Insurers101/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **其定位逐字，是本条目最重要的一段**：**「A free, non-commercial, **educational strategy simulation of U.S. health-insurance economics**. You run one of **four real insurers (Cigna, UnitedHealth Group, Elevance Health, Humana)** for **ten fiscal years, one quarter at a time**, toward a **North Star you choose: shareholder value, population health, or a blend you weight yourself**.」**；**每季四步逐字为**：**「**Underwriting & Pricing → Network & Vendor Deals → Claims Operations → Board Review & Regulation**」**；**并逐字说明**：**「Real-world edge cases interrupt the routine; **each one shows the strategic logic, the controversy, and its sources**. Crises (Distressed, Consent Decree, Takeover Bid) are **recoverable**. **The run ends at quarter 40 with a report card scored exactly as described when you chose your path.**」**；**另逐字声明**：**「**No ads, no accounts, no analytics, no tracking.** Saves live in your browser only.」**。**根目录实测**：**`.gitattributes`（52 字节）、`.github`、`.gitignore`（45 字节）、`.npmrc`（43 字节）、**`ARCHITECTURE.md`（29,534 字节）**、**`CLAUDE.md`（2,564 字节）**、`README.md`（4,238 字节）、`docs/`、`index.html`（681 字节）、`package-lock.json`（38,751 字节）、`package.json`（762 字节）、`public/`、`src/`、`tools/`、`vite.config.js`（665 字节）**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Verify it」一节把自证方式写成四条可执行命令，是本条目最有价值的一处**——**逐字实测**：**① `npm test`（「unit tests for every module (node:test)」）**；**② `node tools/playthrough.mjs`——逐字为「**17 automated 40-quarter runs: 4 insurers × 3 North Stars + stress + acquired ending**」**；**③ `node tools/calibrate.mjs`——逐字为「per-insurer Q1 economics and Q40 trajectory under neutral play」**；**④ `node tools/gauntlet.mjs --drive`——逐字为「**screenshots every showcase and 64 driven game states** → `tools/out/gauntlet/index.html`」**。⭐⭐⭐ **「17 次自动完整通关」的含义值得算清楚**：**4 家保险公司 × 3 个目标 ＝ 12 条主路径**，**再加压力测试与「被收购」结局共 17 条**——**即它把**每条主要路径**都自动跑到了第 40 季**；**而 `--drive` 参数下**再对 64 个受驱状态逐一截图**（**并对每个 showcase 截图**）。⭐⭐ **对一个面向教学的模拟器而言，「能跑完且跑完的结果看起来对」正是它最需要证明的事**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的四条测试不变量、第 328 轮 [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 的 20 个种子并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**这些脚本本次被运行过**——**本次未运行任何一条**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「?drive=… &seed=7」这一 URL 参数把**任意游戏状态变成可寻址的****——**逐字实测为**：**`?drive=<insurer>,<northStar>,<quarter>,<phase>[,<crisis>]&seed=7`**，**并给出示例 `?drive=humana,population,10,board,distressed&seed=7`**——**即可以**直接跳到「Humana、人群健康目标、第 10 季、董事会阶段、困境危机、随机种子 7」这一确定状态****。⭐⭐⭐ **对教学与复现而言，这解决了一个常见难题**：**「我遇到一个奇怪的结果」通常无法传达，而**可寻址的状态＋固定种子**使它可以被分享与重放**（**⚠️ README 未说明 `seed` 是否覆盖全部随机性**——**见标注 ②**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Design in one paragraph」把整个经济模型压缩成一段，且**每条机制都点明了来源或取舍****——**逐字实测**：**「**Money is USD, one turn is one fiscal quarter, all randomness is seeded and logged.** Revenue is **members × premium**; medical cost is **billed cost after network discount and the share of denied dollars actually avoided**; **the medical loss ratio floor triggers rebates when you under-spend**; **the stock re-rates toward EPS × an insurer-specific multiple that flexes with growth, regulatory exposure, crises and reputation**. **Each insurer has a signature claims lever with a real trade-off** (**Cigna’s batch review, UnitedHealth’s route-to-owned, Elevance’s cross-market comparison, Humana’s live star-rating preview**). **Nothing in the UI judges a decision at the moment you make it; consequences arrive later as quiet effects.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **其中三点值得单独记**：**「医疗损失率下限在你花得太少时触发返还」是把美国健康险的**最低赔付率返还（MLR rebate）**写进了模型**；**「每家保险公司有一个招牌理赔杠杆且带有真实取舍」是把四家公司的**实际策略差异**做成了玩法差异**；**而**「界面不在你做决定的当下评判你，后果稍后以安静的方式到来」是一条明确的**教学设计选择****——**它拒绝即时反馈，以迫使玩家自己承担判断**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该设计对学习更有效**——**未经教学效果验证**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ 「Sources and accuracy」一节把**引证要求**写成了硬规定**——**逐字实测**：**「**Every real-event scenario carries at least two citations shown in-game ("Sources") and aggregated in `docs/SOURCES.md`.** **Fictional member vignettes are labelled as composites.** If you find an error, **the scenario files are in `src/scenarios/data/`**.」**——**即每个真实事件情景**至少两条引证**，**在游戏内可见并汇总到 `docs/SOURCES.md`**；**虚构的参保人小故事**明确标注为合成**；**并指出纠错的具体入口**。⭐⭐ **对做行业学习材料的人，这是**把「我说的有依据」变成可核查**的一种具体做法**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **仓库地图里出现了三处少见的自检产物**——**逐字实测**：**`ARCHITECTURE.md`（「**the contract**」）**、**`docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md`（art and tone）**、**`docs/STATUS.json`（「**critic scores and open issues**」）**、**`docs/PROGRESS.md`（handoff）**、**`docs/critic/`（「**audit reports**」）**、**`src/<module>/README.md`（per-module notes）**。⭐⭐⭐ **「`docs/STATUS.json` 存评论者评分与未决问题」与「`docs/critic/` 存审计报告」值得注意**：**它把**对自身作品的批评**当成了仓库的一部分**；**而 `ARCHITECTURE.md` 自述为「the contract（契约）」**说明**架构文件被当作约束而非描述****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其评分与审计报告的内容或严格程度**——**本次未读 `docs/`**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **`CLAUDE.md`（2,564 字节）的存在说明该项目面向**AI 协作开发****——**即仓库内含一份给 AI 编码代理的说明文件**（**⚠️ 本次未读其内容**；**可与本站 [[hx-actuarial-agent-prompts]]、[[dsh-plugin-toolkit]] 等提示词条目并读**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **部署与 CI 逐字实测**：**GitHub Pages**；**「The build uses **relative asset paths**, so it works as a project site (`https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/`) with no configuration.」**；**工作流 `.github/workflows/pages.yml` **在每次推送到 `main` 时运行 `npm ci`、`npm test`、`npm run build` 并发布 `dist/`****。⭐⭐ **注意其 CI 里**包含 `npm test`****——**即**测试不通过则不会发布****（**⚠️ 本次未核实该工作流是否如述**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **运行要求与技术栈逐字**：**`npm install` 后 `npm run dev`，界面在 `http://127.0.0.1:5173`**；**「Requires **Node 20+** and a **desktop browser with WebGL** (the **two three.js scenes fall back to DOM panels** without it)」**；**根目录含 `vite.config.js` 与 `index.html`**——**即基于 Vite**；**⭐ 而「有两处 three.js 场景在没有 WebGL 时回退为 DOM 面板」是一处**明确的无障碍／降级设计****。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **截图巡检的技术细节逐字**：**「The screenshot harness uses **Chrome for Testing** (installed by `puppeteer` into `.tools/puppeteer-cache`).」**——**即它不依赖开发者本机的浏览器**；**而 `tools/serve-static.mjs --prefix insurers-101` 用于**本地模拟子路径部署**（`http://127.0.0.1:4180/insurers-101/`）**——**与环境相关的路径问题被单独测了**。**⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ **版权与商标处理逐字，是本条目在合规自觉上最值得记的一处**：**「Author: Matt Gibson. **License: MIT for code; scenario text is original prose summarising cited public sources. Company names are used factually; accent colours are approximations and no logos are used.**」**——**即**代码为 MIT，情景文本是概述已引证公开来源的原创文字，公司名称属事实性使用，配色为近似且不使用任何标志****（**⚠️ 其中「MIT for code」这一许可声明与仓库无许可文件之间的落差见标注 ①**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站保险教育与模拟条目并读**：[[simulationmachine]]、[[insurance-pricing-demo]]、[[individualclaims-simulator]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]、[[soa-ai-life-challenge]]、[[actuarial-student-competitions]]、[[open-exam-prep]]、[[10life]]、[[aws-insurancelake-etl]]、[[insurance-exam-bank-cn]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**根目录实测无许可文件**（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 **404**）；**而 README 末尾逐字为「License: MIT for code」**——**即声称 MIT 而仓库内无许可文件**。**本词条明确记录这一**声明与实际不一致**的情况**（**⚠️ 这与第 330 轮 [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]]、本轮 [[insurerisk]] 与 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 属同一类**——**本轮四条中有三条声称许可而无许可文件，另有一条（[[claim-ops]]）完全沉默**；**本会话至此共 5 例声称而无文件**）；**使用、修改或再分发其代码或情景文本前必须自行确认授权状况**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「all randomness is seeded and logged」这一陈述的覆盖范围**——**即**是否所有随机性都受 `seed` 控制****；**README 另处的 `?drive=…&seed=7` 暗示种子可控制状态**，**但「seeded and logged」是否指**全部**随机源、以及 log 存于何处，本次未核实**；**这直接影响其**可复现性主张**，**是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其四条验证命令的实际效果**——**本次未运行 `npm test`、`tools/playthrough.mjs`、`tools/calibrate.mjs` 或 `tools/gauntlet.mjs --drive`**；**「17 次自动完整通关」「逐家 Q1 经济与 Q40 轨迹」「64 个受驱状态截图」均为**README 自述****；**本词条**不主张**这些脚本确实存在、能跑通或结果符合预期**；**④ ⭐⭐ **未核实** `docs/STATUS.json` 与 `docs/critic/` 的实际内容（评论者评分与审计报告）**——**本次未读 `docs/` 任何文件**；**亦未读 `ARCHITECTURE.md`（29,534 字节）、`CLAUDE.md`（2,564 字节）与 `docs/SOURCES.md`**；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**「每个真实事件情景至少两条引证」是否属实**，**亦未核实**其引证的来源质量与准确性**（**未读 `docs/SOURCES.md` 与 `src/scenarios/data/`**）；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其实体公司相关信息（Cigna、UnitedHealth Group、Elevance Health、Humana 的业务与财务特征）在模型中的表现是否与公开资料相符**——**本次未读其经济模型实现，**亦未核对任何一家公司的公开披露**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其医学损失率返还（MLR rebate）机制的实现是否符合美国《平价医疗法案》下的实际规则**（**该规则有具体的门槛、计算期间与豁免安排**）；**本词条**不主张**其模拟在任何程度上反映真实监管计算**；**⑧ ⭐ ⚠️ **未访问其在线演示**（`mttgbsn.github.io/Insurers101/`）**，**故**不主张**其当前可访问或行为如述**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目使用四家**真实公司名称与近似配色****——**其 README 声明为事实性使用、不使用标志、配色为近似**；**本词条**不主张**该使用方式不涉及任何商标或人格权问题**（**本次未作法律评估**）；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ 该模拟为**教育用途且自述非商业****，**其模型为**简化****；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的保险公司经营、定价、投资或监管判断**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建与推送同日**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、内容准确性或已被采用**；**⑫ ⭐ 无 topics**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/mttgbsn/Insurers101`、`/readme` 与 `/contents/` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 4,238 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对，含定位段、四步流程、Verify it 四条命令、Design in one paragraph、Sources and accuracy、Repository map 与许可声明）；`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404；**未克隆、未安装、未运行任何脚本、未访问其在线演示、未读 `docs/`、`ARCHITECTURE.md` 与任何源码**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與倉庫根目錄實測**）：**標題逐字「Insurers: 101」**，**署名逐字「by Matt Gibson」**，**並給出在線地址 `https://mttgbsn.github.io/Insurers101/`**。⭐⭐⭐ **定位逐字**：**「A free, non-commercial, **educational strategy simulation of U.S. health-insurance economics**. **Insurers 101** is **an educational strategy simulation of U.S. health-insurance economics** (repository `mttgbsn/Insurers101`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, JavaScript as the primary language, a 636 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-06** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **⚠️ the repository has no licence file at the root (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main), yet its README closes with the verbatim line "License: MIT for code"** (**see note ① below**); it has **no topics**; **the README measures 4,238 bytes**, **and an `ARCHITECTURE.md` of 29,534 bytes and a `CLAUDE.md` of 2,564 bytes are also measurably present**. It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **stating what would count as evidence that it is right**, **and the most thorough in turning "how do I know it runs" into executable commands**.

Verifiable details (**all measured from the README and the repository root**): **the README title reads verbatim "Insurers: 101"**, **credited verbatim "by Matt Gibson"**, **with an online address at `https://mttgbsn.github.io/Insurers101/`**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Its positioning, read verbatim, is the entry’s most important passage**: **"A free, non-commercial, educational strategy simulation of U.S. health-insurance economics. You run one of four real insurers (Cigna, UnitedHealth Group, Elevance Health, Humana) for ten fiscal years, one quarter at a time, toward a North Star you choose: shareholder value, population health, or a blend you weight yourself."**; **the four quarterly steps read verbatim as**: **"Underwriting & Pricing → Network & Vendor Deals → Claims Operations → Board Review & Regulation"**; **and it states verbatim**: **"Real-world edge cases interrupt the routine; each one shows the strategic logic, the controversy, and its sources. Crises (Distressed, Consent Decree, Takeover Bid) are recoverable. The run ends at quarter 40 with a report card scored exactly as described when you chose your path."**; **plus verbatim**: **"No ads, no accounts, no analytics, no tracking. Saves live in your browser only."** **The root measurably contains**: **`.gitattributes` (52 bytes), `.github`, `.gitignore` (45 bytes), `.npmrc` (43 bytes), `ARCHITECTURE.md` (29,534 bytes), `CLAUDE.md` (2,564 bytes), `README.md` (4,238 bytes), `docs/`, `index.html` (681 bytes), `package-lock.json` (38,751 bytes), `package.json` (762 bytes), `public/`, `src/`, `tools/` and `vite.config.js` (665 bytes)**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ A "Verify it" section turning self-substantiation into four executable commands is the entry’s most valuable part** — **read verbatim**: **① `npm test` ("unit tests for every module (node:test)")**; **② `node tools/playthrough.mjs` — verbatim "17 automated 40-quarter runs: 4 insurers × 3 North Stars + stress + acquired ending"**; **③ `node tools/calibrate.mjs` — verbatim "per-insurer Q1 economics and Q40 trajectory under neutral play"**; **④ `node tools/gauntlet.mjs --drive` — verbatim "screenshots every showcase and 64 driven game states → tools/out/gauntlet/index.html"**. ⭐⭐⭐ **The arithmetic of the 17 runs is worth spelling out: 4 insurers × 3 North Stars = 12 main paths, plus a stress run and an acquired ending making 17 — so every main path is automatically played to quarter 40**, **and with `--drive` a further 64 driven states are screenshotted, alongside every showcase**. ⭐⭐ **For a teaching simulator, "it runs to completion and the completions look right" is precisely what most needs demonstrating** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and its four test invariants, and round 328’s [[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] and its 20 seeds**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim these scripts were run — none was**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The `?drive=…&seed=7` URL parameter makes any game state addressable** — **read verbatim as `?drive=<insurer>,<northStar>,<quarter>,<phase>[,<crisis>]&seed=7`**, **with the example `?drive=humana,population,10,board,distressed&seed=7`** — **jumping straight to a deterministic state: Humana, population-health North Star, quarter 10, board phase, distressed crisis, seed 7**. ⭐⭐⭐ **For teaching and reproducibility this solves a common problem: "I got a strange result" is normally impossible to convey, whereas an addressable state plus a fixed seed makes it shareable and replayable** (**⚠️ the README does not say whether `seed` governs all randomness — see note ②**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A "Design in one paragraph" compresses the whole economic model into one paragraph in which each mechanism names its source or its trade-off** — **read verbatim**: **"Money is USD, one turn is one fiscal quarter, all randomness is seeded and logged. Revenue is members × premium; medical cost is billed cost after network discount and the share of denied dollars actually avoided; the medical loss ratio floor triggers rebates when you under-spend; the stock re-rates toward EPS × an insurer-specific multiple that flexes with growth, regulatory exposure, crises and reputation. Each insurer has a signature claims lever with a real trade-off (Cigna’s batch review, UnitedHealth’s route-to-owned, Elevance’s cross-market comparison, Humana’s live star-rating preview). Nothing in the UI judges a decision at the moment you make it; consequences arrive later as quiet effects."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **the medical loss ratio floor triggering rebates when you under-spend writes the U.S. MLR rebate into the model**; **"each insurer has a signature claims lever with a real trade-off" turns the four companies’ actual strategic differences into gameplay differences**; **and "nothing in the UI judges a decision at the moment you make it; consequences arrive later as quiet effects" is an explicit pedagogical choice — refusing immediate feedback so the player must carry the judgement** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim that design teaches better — no learning-outcome evidence exists**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ A "Sources and accuracy" section makes citation a hard requirement** — **read verbatim**: **"Every real-event scenario carries at least two citations shown in-game (\"Sources\") and aggregated in `docs/SOURCES.md`. Fictional member vignettes are labelled as composites. If you find an error, the scenario files are in `src/scenarios/data/`."** ⭐⭐ **A concrete way of turning "what I say is grounded" into something checkable.** **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its repository map names three unusual self-audit artefacts** — **read verbatim**: **`ARCHITECTURE.md` ("the contract")**, **`docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md` (art and tone)**, **`docs/STATUS.json` ("critic scores and open issues")**, **`docs/PROGRESS.md` (handoff)**, **`docs/critic/` ("audit reports")** and **`src/<module>/README.md` (per-module notes)**. ⭐⭐⭐ **Criticism of its own work is kept in the repository, and `ARCHITECTURE.md` calling itself "the contract" treats the architecture file as a constraint rather than a description** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim anything about the content or rigour of those scores and reports — `docs/` was not read**). **⑥ ⭐⭐ The presence of `CLAUDE.md` (2,564 bytes) shows the project is built for AI-assisted development** — **the repository carries instructions addressed to an AI coding agent** (**⚠️ its content was not read**; **readable with the site’s prompt-engineering entries such as [[hx-actuarial-agent-prompts]]**). **⑦ ⭐⭐ Deployment and CI read verbatim**: **GitHub Pages**; **"The build uses relative asset paths, so it works as a project site (`https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/`) with no configuration."**; **and the workflow `.github/workflows/pages.yml` runs `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build` and publishes `dist/` on every push to `main`**. ⭐⭐ **Note that CI includes `npm test`, so a failing test blocks publication** (**⚠️ that workflow was not verified**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Runtime requirements read verbatim**: **`npm install` then `npm run dev`, serving on `http://127.0.0.1:5173`**; **"Requires Node 20+ and a desktop browser with WebGL (the two three.js scenes fall back to DOM panels without it)"**; **and the root carries `vite.config.js` and `index.html`** — **a Vite build**. ⭐ **The WebGL fallback to DOM panels is explicit graceful degradation.** **⑨ ⭐⭐ The screenshot harness reads verbatim**: **"The screenshot harness uses Chrome for Testing (installed by `puppeteer` into `.tools/puppeteer-cache`)."** — **so it does not depend on the developer’s own browser**; **and `tools/serve-static.mjs --prefix insurers-101` reproduces a sub-path deployment locally** — **environment-dependent path problems are tested separately**. **⑩ ⭐⭐⭐ Copyright and trademark handling reads verbatim, the entry’s most notable piece of compliance care**: **"Author: Matt Gibson. License: MIT for code; scenario text is original prose summarising cited public sources. Company names are used factually; accent colours are approximations and no logos are used."** (**⚠️ the gap between the "MIT for code" claim and the absent licence file is covered in note ①**). **⑪ ⭐ Readable with the site’s insurance education and simulation entries**: [[simulationmachine]], [[insurance-pricing-demo]], [[individualclaims-simulator]], [[ifraudsimulator]], [[soa-ai-life-challenge]], [[actuarial-student-competitions]], [[open-exam-prep]], [[10life]], [[aws-insurancelake-etl]] and [[insurance-exam-bank-cn]].

**the entry records this mismatch explicitly** (**⚠️ the same class as round 330’s [[geo-catastrophe-pricing]] and this round’s [[insurerisk]] and [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] — three of this round’s four claim without a file, while [[claim-ops]] is entirely silent; five such claims across this session**); **authorisation must be confirmed before using, modifying or redistributing the code or the scenario text**; **② ⭐⭐⭐ The scope of "all randomness is seeded and logged" was not verified** — **that is, whether every random source is governed by `seed`**; **the separate `?drive=…&seed=7` parameter suggests the seed controls state, but whether "seeded and logged" means all randomness, and where the log is kept, were not verified**; **this bears directly on its reproducibility claim and is the single most important thing to verify next for this entry**; **⑤ ⭐⭐ Whether "every real-event scenario carries at least two citations" is true was not verified**, **nor the quality and accuracy of those citations** (**`docs/SOURCES.md` and `src/scenarios/data/` were not read**);
